overview: Manhattan Racquet Club is a polished, minimal public-facing website for a fictional NYC tennis club. It features four public pages (Landing, About, Membership, Contact) plus a robust admin dashboard with CMS, image management, multi-level admin access, membership enquiries, court bookings, gallery, news, activity log, draft preview, and SEO management.
features: Public pages: Landing, About, Membership, Contact, News, Gallery
Admin dashboard with CMS for all site content
Internet Identity authentication for admin access
Two-tier admin system: Superadmin and Admin roles
Image upload and management via blob storage
Membership enquiry form with admin inbox
Court booking request form with admin management
Photo gallery with admin upload and alt text
Custom 404 page and health check status page
Build safeguards preventing admin lockout and image upload regressions
